title: AI 2040 Plan A — Track 3 contribution mapping
repository_role: Independent open-source research implementation aligned to the public AI 2040 Plan A verification discussion. This repository is not an AI Futures Project publication, certification body, or endorsement.

mappings.ai2040_reference: Verification Plan / Track 3; Covert AI Projects §2.1
mappings.contribution: Expand beyond the 93-site Epoch universe to global compute inventories and auditable organization-level holdings.
mappings.scope_note: Epoch records are a secondary site layer; they are not a complete global compute census.

mappings.track3_element: Trace inputs to AI compute production
mappings.contribution: Preserve production-input snapshots and develop production reconciliation from component supply through finished accelerators.
mappings.scope_note: Source snapshots do not by themselves establish complete vendor production.

mappings.ai2040_reference: Covert AI Projects Recommendation #1 and Appendix B
mappings.contribution: Turn organization sales snapshots into source-specific, dated sales ledgers with provenance and reconciliation checks.
mappings.scope_note: A sales snapshot is not automatically a transaction-level certificate.

mappings.track3_element: Trace sales and resales to physical end use
mappings.ai2040_reference: Covert AI Projects Recommendation #2 and Appendix B
mappings.contribution: Build auditable transfer chains from vendor → customer → reseller/transferee → current physical location.
mappings.scope_note: Public data currently provides only partial organization/site linkage.

mappings.track3_element: Audit large compute owners above threshold T
mappings.contribution: Parameterized threshold audit population protocol with explicit metric definition, entity-resolution, audit states, evidence links and exclusion reasons.
mappings.scope_note: Threshold T remains a Plan A parameter and is intentionally not hard-coded as a current factual threshold.

mappings.ai2040_reference: Covert AI Projects Recommendation #2 and Appendix B
mappings.contribution: Deterministic sampling-frame protocol with declared eligibility, seed, stratification, reproducible selection log and outcome fields.
mappings.scope_note: No sample is claimed until the population and sampling parameters are fixed.

mappings.ai2040_reference: Covert AI Projects Recommendation #2 and Appendix B
mappings.contribution: Physical-inspection evidence schema and chain-of-custody protocol are implemented for future authorized inspections.
Serial continuity lifecycle and transfer-integrity protocol is implemented.
mappings.scope_note: Current serial-level public inventory is not exposed; no serial continuity claim is asserted.

mappings.contribution: Decommissioning/recycling verification schema and independent-corroboration states are implemented.
mappings.scope_note: Current independently verified public decommissioning events: 0.

mappings.contribution: Residual untraced-compute accounting framework is implemented with explicit closure requirements and non-negative residual rule.
mappings.scope_note: Current value remains UNKNOWN because the public transaction-level inventory chain is not closed.

mappings.contribution: Add multi-temporal aerial/thermal/SAR/optical observation records and candidate-site investigations.
mappings.scope_note: Current retained physical layer has 423 derived observations across 68/93 Epoch sites; 25 sites still lack a retained derived observation. This does not establish global covert-site absence.

mappings.contribution: Voluntary disclosure/amnesty/buyback evidence protocol is implemented with explicit verification states.
mappings.scope_note: This is a protocol surface; no verified disclosure or buyback events are claimed.

mappings.ai2040_reference: Covert AI Projects Recommendation #3; Verification Plan
mappings.contribution: Expand site discovery beyond the current Epoch universe and preserve source-level observations.
mappings.scope_note: 93-site Epoch universe plus broader queue surveillance; no intelligence-source corpus or global covert-site census is available publicly in this repository.

mappings.contribution: Add interval demand, site thermal observations, cooling equipment, transformer delivery, and corroboration links.
mappings.scope_note: Current annual electricity snapshots and selected cooling records are supporting evidence, not complete telemetry.

mappings.ai2040_reference: Track 3 / Covert AI Projects supply-chain tracing
mappings.contribution: Expose raw publisher values, capture hashes, and normalization without falsely converting aggregate sources into site-level claims.
mappings.scope_note: Organization-level source snapshots require independent site linkage before site attribution.

mappings.contribution: Global public-source catalog and aggregate compute supply-chain layer extend beyond North American grid records.
mappings.scope_note: Site-level physical registry remains predominantly North American.
